body:
### Summary

`uv lock` time grows exponentially with the number of extras declared mutually-exclusive in one `[tool.uv] conflicts` group — but only when the project also has a dependency shared across those forks with a large release history (e.g. `transformers`). It roughly doubles every 5-10 extras (24s at N=50 → 110s at N=65), and past a threshold (~70 in the minimal repro below) it no longer completes within any reasonable time.


### Minimal reproduction

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# repro.sh - for each N, generates a pyproject.toml with N empty extras all
# declared mutually exclusive in one [tool.uv] conflicts group, plus one real
# dependency (transformers, chosen for its large release history), and times
# `uv lock`. Prints the full table from this report.
set -euo pipefail
TIMEOUT_S="${TIMEOUT_S:-120}"

gen_pyproject() {
  local n="$1" workdir="$2"
  {
    echo '[project]'
    echo 'name = "repro"'
    echo 'version = "0.0.1"'
    echo 'requires-python = ">=3.10,<3.15"'
    echo 'dependencies = ["transformers>=4.40.0,<6.0.0"]'
    echo
    echo '[project.optional-dependencies]'
    for ((i = 0; i < n; i++)); do echo "e${i} = []"; done
    echo
    echo '[tool.uv]'
    printf 'conflicts = [\n    ['
    for ((i = 0; i < n; i++)); do
      printf '{ extra = "e%d" }' "$i"
      [ "$i" -lt $((n - 1)) ] && printf ', '
    done
    printf '],\n]\n'
  } > "$workdir/pyproject.toml"
}

echo "uv: $(uv --version)"
echo

for n in 5 10 20 30 40 50 55 60 65 70 80 90; do
  workdir="$(mktemp -d -t uv-conflicts-repro-XXXXXX)"
  gen_pyproject "$n" "$workdir"
  start=$(date +%s.%N)
  if timeout "$TIMEOUT_S" uv lock --project "$workdir" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    outcome="resolved"
  else
    [ $? -eq 124 ] && outcome="TIMEOUT(${TIMEOUT_S}s)" || outcome="error"
  fi
  end=$(date +%s.%N)
  elapsed=$(awk "BEGIN { printf \"%.1f\", $end - $start }")
  printf 'n=%-4s  %-16s  %6ss\n' "$n" "$outcome" "$elapsed"
  rm -rf "$workdir"
done
```

```bash
chmod +x repro.sh
./repro.sh
```

### Timings

| N extras in the group | time |
|---|---|
| 5 | 0.0s |
| 10 | 0.0s |
| 20 | 0.2s |
| 30 | 1.2s |
| 40 | 6.5s |
| 50 | 23.4s |
| 55 | 41.0s |
| 60 | 70.7s |
| 65 | 109.9s |
| 70 | doesn't finish within 120s |
| 80 | doesn't finish within 120s |
| 90 | doesn't finish within 120s |

Grouping shape: splitting the same total extras into many small *disjoint* `conflicts` groups performs identically to one big group — it's the total distinct extra count across `conflicts`, not group size or group count, that predicts the time.

### Context

Found while investigating `uv lock` runs that took multiple hours on [embeddings-benchmark/mteb](https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/mteb) — one run [wasn't finished after 12 hours](https://github.com/embeddings-benchmark/mteb/issues/5482) and had to be killed. mteb declares ~44 extras mutually exclusive in one group alongside `transformers`/`torch`/`sentence-transformers` as base deps (their real threshold was ~40, lower than this single-dependency repro's ~65 — consistent with multiple large-history deps compounding).

### Related issues

- **#21399**: same *kind* of fix, but scoped to workspaces with many member projects — doesn't cover a single project's own `conflicts` group.
- **#18317**: lock file size scaling with `conflicts`.
- **#17990**: asks for conflicting groups to resolve as independent targets instead of one universal resolution — would likely fix this too.


### Platform

\macOS 27.0 arm64

### Version

uv 0.12.17

### Python version

_No response_
title: `uv lock` scales exponentially with the size of a single `[tool.uv] conflicts` group
